subject: Evidence delivery and temporary auditor access — reissue request
messages:
From: Lucy Hayes <lucy.hayes@acuityaudit.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@finledger.com
Date: 2028-08-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: evidence hand-off and temporary access for SOC 2 review

Hi Sofia / Marissa,

We're starting evidence collection for FinLedger's SOC 2 Type II review this week. The testing team needs view/download access to the Redwood evidence bundle and the control testing artifacts. Per the onboarding doc, we tried the one-time trust portal link issued earlier but several of our reviewers couldn't download large bundles before the link expired.

Can you:
- Re-issue a short-lived access window (48-72 hours) scoped to FinLedger reviewers only?
- Confirm whether the portal preserves the original filenames (we saw some truncation in the last pass)
- Provide a signed statement (simple PDF) that the audit window will be followed by immediate deprovisioning (FinLedger legal requires this for their records)

If you prefer, we can schedule a 30-minute hand-off call so we can grab anything that still needs manual transfer.

Attachments: request_checklist.xlsx (stub)

Thanks,
Lucy Hayes
Senior Manager, Acuity Audit LLP
lucy.hayes@acuityaudit.com
+1-415-555-0199
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lucy Hayes <lucy.hayes@acuityaudit.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-08-22T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: evidence hand-off and temporary access for SOC 2 review

Hi Lucy — thanks for the note.

We can definitely reissue a contained access window. A couple of clarifications so we scope it correctly:
- Desired window: do you want a continuous 72-hr download window, or two adjacent 48-hr windows for separate reviewer sets?
- IP restrictions: do you need the access limited to a set of IPs? If so, please send the CIDR ranges.
- Bridge statement: we can provide a short signed letter that confirms deprovisioning once the window closes (1–2 page PDF).

Plan I propose now:
1) We reissue a one-time Trust Portal link scoped to FinLedger reviewers, 72-hour window starting when you confirm readiness.
2) We will attach a signed deprovisioning confirmation PDF and an evidence index (SOC2_TypeII_summary_2027.pdf).
3) If any files fail to download, Ben will do a manual SFTP handoff during a scheduled 30-min session.

Please confirm the window length and whether you want IP restrictions. If you confirm within the hour, we can start the invite flow and I will share the portal link.

— Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Trust & Compliance | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com
From: Lucy Hayes <lucy.hayes@acuityaudit.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, FinLedger Security <security@finledger.com>
Date: 2028-08-22T11:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: evidence hand-off and temporary access for SOC 2 review

Thanks Sofia — 72 hours works and we don't need IP restrictions for this pass. We have two reviewer groups (controls and infra) who may download concurrently; please scope the link to both groups.

Quick notes from the field: several of our reviewers saw filename truncation when bundle size exceeded 2 GB — if the evidence index lists original names, that will help our mapping.

We had one problem this morning: the first link you sent apparently expired before a couple of our reviewers could get the larger archives. Could you reissue and set the start window to begin at 12:00 PM PT? That gives our west-coast reviewers time to be on call.

If possible we would also like the deprovisioning statement to include a timestamped note (UTC) of when access is revoked. That helps FinLedger's compliance team reconcile logs.

If anything goes wrong during the 72-hour window we will request an SFTP fallback — appreciate Ben being on standby.

- Attached: SOC2_TypeII_summary_2027.pdf (evidence index) and a signed Deprovisioning Confirmation PDF with revocation timestamp in UTC.
